findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could provide a filePath that includes shell metacharacters, leading to OS command execution.
findings.assumptions: The filePath is derived from untrusted input, and the environment where this code runs allows shell metacharacters to be interpreted.
